006package dev.metaschema.core.datatype.adapter;
007
008import com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.jsonFormatVisitors.JsonFormatTypes;
009
010import java.time.DateTimeException;
011import java.time.ZonedDateTime;
012import java.time.format.DateTimeParseException;
013import java.util.List;
014import java.util.regex.Matcher;
015import java.util.regex.Pattern;
016
017import dev.metaschema.core.datatype.AbstractDataTypeAdapter;
018import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.MetapathConstants;
019import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.item.atomic.IDateWithTimeZoneItem;
020import dev.metaschema.core.qname.EQNameFactory;
021import dev.metaschema.core.qname.IEnhancedQName;
022import dev.metaschema.core.util.ObjectUtils;
023import edu.umd.cs.findbugs.annotations.NonNull;
024
025/**
026 * Support for the Metaschema <a href=
027 * "https://pages.nist.gov/metaschema/specification/datatypes/#date-with-timezone">date-with-timezone</a>
028 * data type.
029 */
030public class DateWithTZAdapter
031    extends AbstractDataTypeAdapter<ZonedDateTime, IDateWithTimeZoneItem> {
032  @NonNull
033  private static final List<IEnhancedQName> NAMES = ObjectUtils.notNull(
034      List.of(
035          EQNameFactory.instance().newQName(MetapathConstants.NS_METAPATH, "date-with-timezone")));
036  private static final Pattern DATE_TIMEZONE = Pattern.compile("^("
037      + "^(?:(?:2000|2400|2800|(?:19|2[0-9](?:0[48]|[2468][048]|[13579][26])))-02-29)"
038      + "|(?:(?:(?:19|2[0-9])[0-9]{2})-02-(?:0[1-9]|1[0-9]|2[0-8]))"
039      + "|(?:(?:(?:19|2[0-9])[0-9]{2})-(?:0[13578]|10|12)-(?:0[1-9]|[12][0-9]|3[01]))"
040      + "|(?:(?:(?:19|2[0-9])[0-9]{2})-(?:0[469]|11)-(?:0[1-9]|[12][0-9]|30))"
041      + ")"
042      + "(Z|[+-][0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2})$");
043
044  DateWithTZAdapter() {
045    super(ZonedDateTime.class, IDateWithTimeZoneItem.class, IDateWithTimeZoneItem::cast);
046  }
047
048  @Override
049  public List<IEnhancedQName> getNames() {
050    return NAMES;
051  }
052
053  @Override
054  public JsonFormatTypes getJsonRawType() {
055    return JsonFormatTypes.STRING;
056  }
057
058  @SuppressWarnings("null")
059  @Override
060  public ZonedDateTime parse(String value) {
061    Matcher matcher = DATE_TIMEZONE.matcher(value);
062    if (!matcher.matches()) {
063      throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid date: " + value);
064    }
065    String parseValue = String.format("%sT00:00:00%s", matcher.group(1), matcher.group(2));
066    try {
067      return ZonedDateTime.from(DateFormats.DATE_TIME_WITH_TZ.parse(parseValue));
068    } catch (DateTimeParseException ex) {
069      throw new IllegalArgumentException(ex.getLocalizedMessage(), ex);
070    }
071  }
072
073  @SuppressWarnings("null")
074  @Override
075  public String asString(Object value) {
076    try {
077      return DateFormats.DATE_WITH_TZ.format(toValue(value));
078    } catch (DateTimeException ex) {
079      throw new IllegalArgumentException(
080          String.format("The provided value '%s' cannot be formatted as a date value. %s",
081              value.toString(),
082              ex.getMessage()),
083          ex);
084    }
085  }
086
087  @SuppressWarnings("null")
088  @Override
089  public ZonedDateTime copy(Object obj) {
090    return ZonedDateTime.from((ZonedDateTime) obj);
091  }
092
093  @Override
094  public IDateWithTimeZoneItem newItem(Object value) {
095    ZonedDateTime item = toValue(value);
096    return IDateWithTimeZoneItem.valueOf(item);
097  }
098}
